top_signals.title: ‘Brilliant and provocative’ columnist and broadcaster Rod Liddle dies aged 66
top_signals.summary: The writer and broadcaster Rod Liddle has died at the age of 66.  Liddle, a titan of Fleet Street, died at hospital in Middlesbrough on Sunday evening following a short illness. The journalist, who wrote columns for The Sunday Times, The Spectator and The Sun, was previously the editor of BBC Radio 4’s Today programme. [...]
